inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The comparison names and cites the closest relevant work, distinguishes the joint higher-content, zero-content, formal-object, and compact-uniform dependency design, and keeps any novelty or priority statement within the cited evidence.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Manuscript-side comparison text names and cites the closest relevant local-obstruction, fail-fast or falsification-first, formal-product, and certificate-methods work; distinguishes the combined higher-content, zero-content, formal-object, and compact-uniform dependency design; and confines every novelty or priority statement to what the cited evidence supports.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix supplies a closest-work comparison or identifies part of the combined dependency design but leaves relevant closest work unnamed or uncited, leaves one design component undistinguished, or retains novelty/priority language beyond the cited evidence.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, closest-work comparison becomes less specific, the combined dependency design becomes less distinguishable from prior work, or novelty/priority language becomes stronger without cited support.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis only: §1 Introduction and §8 Acknowledged Limitations, especially roadmap-proposed blocks B0018 (replace_block or insert_after) and B0112 (replace_block); equivalent evidence elsewhere counts, and location alone does not.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The cited locator resolves to the frozen package, the manifest lists every claimed current artifact with its hash and schema version, access conditions are explicit, and future scientific dossiers remain identified as absent.

operationalization.fully_addressed: A manuscript-cited stable locator resolves to the frozen current package, and its manifest lists every claimed current artifact by filename with SHA-256 value, schema version, and access condition; every uncreated future scientific dossier is explicitly identified as absent.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix supplies a locator or manifest but it does not resolve the frozen current package, omits at least one claimed current artifact or required filename/hash/schema/access field, or fails to identify an uncreated future scientific dossier as absent.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, current-artifact reproducibility claims broaden while stable access or manifest fields diminish, or an uncreated scientific dossier is presented less explicitly as absent.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript title explicitly identifies the higher- and zero-content tests as prospective or architectural and does not imply execution of a factor, comparison, obstruction, panel, or limit, consistently with the abstract's stated nonexecution boundary.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Each formal object and operation has a typed definition and stated domain, codomain, topology, and equality relation; transition and projection compatibility are proved or the affected comparison remains explicitly unavailable.

operationalization.fully_addressed: For each positive-content or zero-content formal object and every transition, localization, projection, equality, or other operation used in a comparison, the manuscript gives a typed definition with domain, codomain, topology, and equality notion and proves the required transition/projection compatibility; for any element not so defined or proved, the affected comparison is explicitly unavailable.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix defines or proves compatibility for some objects or operations but leaves at least one comparison-dependent object or operation without a required type/domain/codomain/topology/equality/compatibility component and does not mark the affected comparison explicitly unavailable.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, an undefined or compatibility-unproved object or operation is used in more comparisons, an affected comparison is presented as more available, or any stated type, domain, codomain, topology, equality notion, or compatibility boundary is lost.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Every analytic claim in the manuscript resolves to one registry row with explicit indices, coupling, compact domain, limit order, majorant obligation, and interchange statement; sampled or finite diagnostics remain separately labeled.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Every proposed analytic claim maps to a manuscript-side registry row that explicitly names its indices, index coupling, compact domain, iterated or diagonal limit order, absolute-majorant obligation, and proposed interchange; every sampled or finite diagnostic is separately labeled or typed as such.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix registers only some analytic claims or leaves at least one row without an explicit index, coupling, compact domain, limit order, absolute-majorant obligation, or interchange statement, or does not keep a finite diagnostic separately typed.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, an analytic claim loses a registered index/coupling/domain/order/majorant/interchange condition, an unregistered claim is added, or a finite diagnostic is treated more strongly as analytic-limit evidence.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Every manuscript occurrence of P32-S13 uses one authoritative bibliographic identity state; any documented transition between states is explained; and the identity state is represented separately from background-only claim fitness and claim-to-passage or passage-level support uncertainty.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix harmonizes only some P32-S13 occurrences, leaves a state transition unexplained, or continues to conflate bibliographic identity with background-only claim fitness or passage-level support.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, P32-S13 appears under more inconsistent identity states, a state transition becomes less explained, or identity status becomes more conflated with claim fitness or passage support.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript supplies one complete criterion-permitted branch: either a conditional ownerwise scalar lemma with explicit assumptions or hypotheses, domain, and equality comparator, or a formal argument showing why that comparator is inadmissible for the ownerwise question and why singleton projection is necessary; in either branch, no unexecuted result is assigned scientific or Route credit.
